title: Void11 Dropper
description: a utility mod for afking on void11 or any other server with a random item system
body:
# v11 dropper

v11 dropper is a fabric client-side utility mod made for fast item dropping and automatic chest sorting.  
it adds two simple toggles that automate afker sorting and afking while keeping performance smooth.

## features

### item auto-drop
press **k** to toggle auto-drop.  
any item *not* on the whitelist gets thrown out of your inventory automatically.

### chest sorting
press **l** to toggle chest sorting.  
behavior changes based on the container:
- **large chests** → moves whitelisted items to your inv + throws trash
- **netherite shop** → matches items and auto-moves them
- **sell menu** → auto-sells any whitelisted items
- **containers matching whitelist item ids** → moves matching items into the chest

## whitelist
the whitelist is stored in:

```
/config/V11Dropper/whitelist.txt
```

default entries include sellable items like:
- netherite ingot
- trident
- dragon head
- elytra
- enchanted golden apple
- etc

add or remove items using their full minecraft ids (ex: `minecraft:mace`).

## keybinds
| action | default key |
|--------|-------------|
| toggle dropping | **k** |
| toggle chest sorting | **l** |

keybinds can be changed in minecraft's controls menu.

## install
1. install fabric api
2. drop the mod into your mods folder
3. launch the game

## notes
- may work on other servers besides void11.net
- preset configs in /config-presets
